item.title: Our take on Chaosium’s updated store locator
item.description: Find your nearest friendly local gaming store using our hacked Mythos-themed store locator. We’ve wrapped Chaosium’s map in an "occult haze"—dare you break the seal to find hidden archives in Salem, Providence, and beyond?

item.title: Tactile logic puzzles from Christoph Lohe and Yavuz Demirhan surge on Kickstarter
item.description: Puzzle Master celebrates thirty years of brain teasers with a new Kickstarter campaign. Explore intricate designs like the Fortress of Shadows and the Crazy Lock by master designers Christoph Lohe and Yavuz Demirhan.

item.title: The Amulet of Life: Cult roleplaying series reborn as a cinematic event
item.description: Realm of LARP returns as a 101-minute feature film titled The Amulet of Life, with fans deciding the future of the series through a global gaming challenge.

item.title: “Goth Jumanji” comes to Bundle of Holding: Get DIE: The RPG for $14.95
item.description: Bundle of Holding has a new deal for DIE: The RPG, the "Goth Jumanji" game from Kieron Gillen and Stephanie Hans. Get the core book and three scenario volumes for $14.95.

item.title: Review: Snail Mail -The RPG
item.description: Ri Laine Hastings invites players to a world of tiny stakes in Snail Mail: The RPG. We review this solo-friendly game about delivering post in a dangerous garden.

item.title: The best-selling modules on Fantasy Grounds in 2025
item.description: What defined the VTT landscape in 2025? We analyse the official Fantasy Grounds top 10 bestsellers list, exploring the enduring power of D&D and the rise of the digital dice economy.

item.title: Beyond D&D: The best-selling RPGs on Fantasy Grounds in 2025
item.description: What are VTT players buying when they aren't buying D&D? We reveal the true best-sellers on Fantasy Grounds in 2025, featuring the rise of Shadowdark and the triumph of the Pathfinder Remaster.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #341
item.description: A new Four Against Darkness edition, The Snarl playtest, and Fantasy Grounds top sellers headline our latest TTRPG news summary and reviews.

item.title: Changing class names until D&D is low-key sinister
item.description: Rebranding a class changes how a player interacts with the world. A wizard who is an Academic or a Censor treats reality like a document to be edited. These sinister titles shift the focus from heroic fantasy to a cold and clinical obsession.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #314 – The VTT ecosystem
item.description: Analyse the 2025 VTT ecosystem with an in-depth look at the top-selling modules on Fantasy Grounds. This episode explores why Shadowdark and Pathfinder are dominating the charts and reviews new roleplaying games like Runeway and Snail Mail.
